Limitations

5 m grid: rocks smaller than ~5 m are not resolved. Around Gediz Vallis the DEM has much less fine detail than at the boxwork (likely lower-resolution fill), so slopes there are smoothed. Routes are a rough Tobler-based estimate (suit speed ×0.5, slopes >25° blocked) for comparison only; Nigel's planner is the reference.
